operations.description: Deletes the specified data source. The request will fail if the data source contains any data points.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] fitness users data sources delete [PATH] data sources [PARAMS] alt data fields id ip key oauth pretty print quota source token user [SCHEMA] application data device field source type

operations.description: Performs an inclusive delete of all data points whose start and end times have any overlap with the time range specified by the dataset ID. For most data types, the entire data point will be deleted. For data types where the time span represents a consistent value (such as com.google.activity.segment), and a data point straddles either end point of the dataset, only the overlapping portion of the data point will be deleted.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] fitness users data sources datasets delete [PATH] data sources datasets [PARAMS] alt current data dataset fields id ip key millis modified oauth pretty print quota source time token user [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Deletes a session specified by the given session ID.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] fitness users sessions delete [PATH] sessions [PARAMS] alt current fields id ip key millis oauth pretty print quota session time token user [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Lists all data sources that are visible to the developer, using the OAuth scopes provided. The list is not exhaustive; the user may have private data sources that are only visible to other developers, or calls using other scopes.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] fitness users data sources list [PATH] data sources [PARAMS] alt data fields id ip key name oauth pretty print quota token type user [SCHEMA] application data device list response source sources type
[METHOD] get [NAME] fitness users data sources [PATH] data sources [PARAMS] alt data fields id ip key oauth pretty print quota source token user [SCHEMA] application data device field source type

operations.description: Queries for user's data point changes for a particular data source.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] fitness users data sources data point changes list [PATH] data sources data point changes [PARAMS] alt data fields id ip key limit oauth page pretty print quota source token user [SCHEMA] changes data list point response value

operations.description: Returns a dataset containing all data points whose start and end times overlap with the specified range of the dataset minimum start time and maximum end time. Specifically, any data point whose start time is less than or equal to the dataset end time and whose end time is greater than or equal to the dataset start time.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] fitness users data sources datasets [PATH] data sources datasets [PARAMS] alt data dataset fields id ip key limit oauth page pretty print quota source token user [SCHEMA] data dataset point value

[METHOD] get [NAME] fitness users sessions list [PATH] sessions [PARAMS] alt deleted end fields id include ip key oauth page pretty print quota start time token user [SCHEMA] application list response session sessions

operations.description: Adds data points to a dataset. The dataset need not be previously created. All points within the given dataset will be returned with subsquent calls to retrieve this dataset. Data points can belong to more than one dataset. This method does not use patch semantics.
operations.T: [METHOD] patch [NAME] fitness users data sources datasets patch [PATH] data sources datasets [PARAMS] alt current data dataset fields id ip key millis oauth pretty print quota source time token user [SCHEMA] data dataset point value

operations.description: Creates a new data source that is unique across all data sources belonging to this user. The data stream ID field can be omitted and will be generated by the server with the correct format. The data stream ID is an ordered combination of some fields from the data source. In addition to the data source fields reflected into the data source ID, the developer project number that is authenticated when creating the data source is included. This developer project number is obfuscated when read by any other developer reading public data types.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] fitness users data sources create [PATH] data sources [PARAMS] alt fields id ip key oauth pretty print quota token user [SCHEMA] application data device field source type

operations.description: Aggregates data of a certain type or stream into buckets divided by a given type of boundary. Multiple data sets of multiple types and from multiple sources can be aggreated into exactly one bucket type per request.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] fitness users dataset aggregate [PATH] dataset aggregate [PARAMS] alt fields id ip key oauth pretty print quota token user [SCHEMA] activity aggregate bucket by dataset period request response session time

operations.description:
Updates the specified data source. The dataStreamId, dataType, type, dataStreamName, and device properties with the exception of version, cannot be modified.

Data sources are identified by their dataStreamId.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] fitness users data sources update [PATH] data sources [PARAMS] alt data fields id ip key oauth pretty print quota source token user [SCHEMA] application data device field source type

operations.description: Updates or insert a given session.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] fitness users sessions update [PATH] sessions [PARAMS] alt current fields id ip key millis oauth pretty print quota session time token user [SCHEMA] application session
